SmileBASIC companion

Use a separate program slot after saving your work. Keep NS2/NS2GOOD intact. This small script records a variable in RAM:

PORTALMARK=271026
PRINT "PORTAL BASELINE"
PRINT PORTALMARK
END

After visiting the portal and returning to Direct mode, enter PRINT PORTALMARK,271027. Record the actual output or error. A retained value is interpreter continuity evidence. This companion has been prepared on the Mac and has not been run on the Switch.

Feature names, successful tests, and browser hardware hints are separate evidence. A browser connection alone does not establish native code execution.
